§5.1 시범 시나리오 3 사건 오프라인 패키지 사전 적재
architecture: §4.1 Web 상황판 역할: 오프라인 패키지 적재 미완료 경고 배지
context_refs.boundaries: spec/boundaries.md §3 S7, §4.4 Event Catalog, §7 API Index, §9.2 Board Shell Slots
harness: SC-03 사건 오프라인 패키지 사전 적재
SC-04 지도 기준 범위·구역 분할·할당 (manifest stale 경유)
SC-07 통신 단절 중 로컬 기록 (package availability 경유)

included: tileserver-gl container route and local MapLibre style
사건 메타, 실종자 운영 캐시, OP, 담당 구역, 초기 마커, 지도 기준 범위, 지도 타일을 포함하는 단일 패키지 계약
map_boundary 변경에 따른 manifest revision 증가와 stale package 표시
사건 종료/purge 시 package manifest/status 및 로컬 패키지 파기 hook

excluded.reason: S7은 초기 마커 read model만 manifest에 포함한다.

excluded.item: 지도 기준 범위와 수색 구역 geometry write
excluded.reason: S7은 MapBoundaryQuery와 assigned area query 결과를 소비해 tile coverage와 package payload를 만든다.

excluded.item: OP 생성, OP assignment write, 인수인계 메모
excluded.reason: S7은 current/list OP와 assignment read contract만 소비한다.
S7 package status는 입력 source이며 로컬 경고 UI와 retry scheduler는 S6 소유다.
S7은 PackageStatusQuery와 이벤트를 제공하고 S3-2가 package_badge slot에 표시한다.

fr_mapping.summary: 오프라인 지도 표시를 위해 사전 다운로드된 영역에서 지도 타일을 사용할 수 있다.
fr_mapping.handling: 자체 tileserver-gl endpoint와 manifest tile set을 통해 Android/Web MapLibre가 같은 OSM/OpenMapTiles 기반 타일을 사용한다.

fr_mapping.summary: 사건 화면에서 실종자 기본 정보를 오프라인에서도 확인할 수 있게 한다.
fr_mapping.handling: manifest는 missing person cache와 사진 참조를 포함해 사건 배정 단말의 오프라인 사건 화면에서 조회 가능하게 한다. tile/style endpoint는 FR-19/FR-31 구현 계약으로 다룬다.
S7은 package status와 manifest item status를 제공하고 S6 LocalWarningMonitor가 앱 경고로 표시한다.

패키지는 타일 단독이 아니라 incident metadata, missing person cache, OP, assigned areas, initial markers, map boundary, tile references를 포함하며, map_boundary revision 변경 시 offline_package_status를 STALE로 수렴시키고 재다운로드 대상을 분리한다.

consumed.usage: manifest incident metadata와 missing person cache 포함, closed incident package write 차단.
manifest app fetch와 status write의 device authorization, device별 status key.
tile coverage, map boundary package item, assigned areas package item 생성.
offline_package_status commit 후 S7이 PublishRequest.PACKAGE_STATUS_CHANGED를 생성해 EventHub.publish(PublishRequest...)를 호출한다. event_outbox row 적재와 fanout은 S4 소유다.
초기 기준 마커와 seed/reference markers를 manifest에 포함.
Android status write는 Outbox/idempotency 경유로 전송.
OP 목록, current OP, 담당 구역 assignment를 manifest에 포함.

events_published.trigger: offline_package_status row commit after app status report or manifest revision staleness update

events_subscribed.handler: manifest revision을 증가시키고 기존 READY/PARTIAL status를 STALE로 표시한다.
assigned area package item 후보를 최신화한다.
current OP package item을 최신화하고 필요 시 manifest revision을 증가시킨다.
device/team별 assigned area item을 최신화하고 status 재적재 필요 여부를 계산한다.
신규 manifest/status write를 차단하고 local package purge 대상 상태를 제공한다.
offline_package_manifest/status purge hook 완료 후 remaining package read를 차단한다.

acceptance_criteria.then: manifest includes incident metadata, missing person cache, OP, assigned areas when present, initial markers, map boundary, and tileItems in one package contract

acceptance_criteria.then: manifest still includes OP1, map boundary, initial markers, device identity context, and tileItems so patrol/foot search can start

acceptance_criteria.given: package download partially fails on tile and marker items
acceptance_criteria.then: status remains not ready for offline use, failed item keys are preserved, and PACKAGE_STATUS_CHANGED is published

acceptance_criteria.then: old device status becomes STALE and S3-2 package_badge can show re-download required

acceptance_criteria.then: API rejects with write_conflict and app must not show ready_for_offline_use

acceptance_criteria.when: request is authorized as web user
acceptance_criteria.then: API returns 403 channel_not_allowed and no status/event row is written

acceptance_criteria.given: SC-09 package status write is replayed through S6 Outbox and S7 commits offline_package_status
acceptance_criteria.when: S7 publishes PACKAGE_STATUS_CHANGED and S3-2 package_badge projection consumes it

edge_cases: Manifest has no assignedAreas because 초동 순찰차 수색 starts before area split
Map boundary exists but tile coverage calculation exceeds harness maximum tile count
Tile server is reachable for style JSON but a subset of pbf tiles returns 404/503
Device retries status with same Idempotency-Key and identical body
Device retries status with same Idempotency-Key but different body
OP_TRANSITIONED occurs while package download is in progress
INCIDENT_CLOSED arrives while device is offline with partially downloaded package
OSM attribution is missing from style metadata
Style JSON includes external tile URL

error_handling.tile_unavailable: Manifest fetch or tile/style endpoint returns 503; app keeps completed items and allows failed item retry.
error_handling.write_conflict: Reject READY/PARTIAL status for old or expired manifest and require manifest refresh before ready_for_offline_use.
error_handling.map_boundary_required: Manifest fetch fails until S2 provides active map_boundary; app shows package unavailable instead of tile-only fallback.
error_handling.device_not_registered: Reject manifest/status request and prevent local package save.
error_handling.device_not_assigned: Reject manifest/status request and show authorization failure distinct from retryable network failure.
error_handling.channel_not_allowed: Reject web status writes; web may only read package status through S3-2 package_badge path.
error_handling.incident_closed: Reject new status writes and expose purge-required local package state.
error_handling.idempotency_mismatch: Return 409 and keep previous status response cached; do not publish a second event.

performance: Manifest generation should use cached tile coverage per incident/map_boundary revision where possible.
Status write should publish PACKAGE_STATUS_CHANGED within the common event convergence target.
Tile endpoints must support repeated Android retry without changing package item checksum.
security: Manifest and tile/style endpoints require authenticated APP or WEB channel in harness.
App manifest/status access requires registered and assigned Device.
Manifest must not include internal purge_run, location_access_log, event_outbox, or notification_delivery details.
Closed incident manifest must not expose missing person PII or package re-download links.
observability: Expose manifest generation count and latency by incidentId/revision.
Expose package status counts by status and incident.
Expose tile_unavailable count by style/z/x/y and tileserver health.
licensing: OSM attribution must be present in style JSON metadata and visible to MapLibre consumers.
No external tile hosts are allowed in harness style sources.
